'''Command Bunker 0-Y2''' was one of several bunkers constructed and manned by the [[Order of Revan]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] around [[3637 BBY]]. During the [[Battle of Rishi]] the bunker was used by Commander [[Mokan]] and was assaulted by a strike team making its way to the large signal jammer located on the island.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Command Bunker 0-Y2 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion during the "Battle of Rishi" flashpoint.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
